discussion_comments.comment_body: This is by design. The override semantics are "full replacement", not "partial merge". When a user configures an override, they explicitly choose which items and prices apply during that period. If they only add prompt_tokens, it means they want to control just that item — other items default to 0 during the override, which is a valid use case (e.g., free completion tokens during a promotion). The editor supports adding multiple item codes per override, so the user has full control. Changing to merge semantics would make the behavior less predictable.
